capabilities: Export single files, canvas pages, or whole vaults as HTML
Bundle HTML and dependencies into one single file
Include full text search, file navigation tree, outline, and graph view in exports
Render output from other plugins such as dataview and tasks
Toggle between themes in the exported site
disambiguation: Not just a single-page converter; it can export the whole vault with interactive features like search and graph view.
extras: Detailed usage docs live at docs.obsidianweb.net rather than in the README. The README warns the plugin is under development with frequent large changes and bugs, and asks users to report issues. Beta versions can be installed via BRAT. Development is funded through donations (with a PayPal option), and testing uses BrowserStack.
motivation: The author notes the plugin takes a lot of work to maintain, but gives no reason for originally building it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export an entire vault or canvas as self-contained HTML files that can be hosted anywhere as a website.
summary: HTML exporter that turns single files, canvas pages, or whole vaults into publishable HTML with search, navigation, and graph view.
